boundaries: The exact KuKo 2D teacher remains frozen as the regression anchor.
Projection-Locked Lift R01 remains a bridge for validating the 2D interpretation; it is not the native 3D answer.
Native 3D R02 does not preserve a fixed XY projection. Camera orientation never participates in generation.
KuKo BR/ANG contribute candidate branching voices only; they are not species facts.
Native 3D R02 is not assigned to Pandanus tectorius or any other species.
Light, occupancy, gravity and obstacle fields may change bud release and 3D direction before a branch exists.
Wind force propagation and botanical radius mechanics remain incomplete.
